Messages.Body:
Ok now it's one of those days again when you get really confused by
melee dmg, strength and whatever.

If someone has a vamp with strength 1 and Kali's Fang, he does 2 agg
dmg on a strike right? What if he has strength 2 or strength 0 (through
disease)?

Before you buy.

Messages.Author: pallando
Messages.Body:
cantila <rogc...@student.luth.se> schrieb in im Newsbeitrag:
913e8p$tfq$1...@nnrp1.deja.com...

> Ok now it's one of those days again when you get really confused by
> melee dmg, strength and whatever.
>
> If someone has a vamp with strength 1 and Kali's Fang, he does 2 agg
> dmg on a strike right? What if he has strength 2 or strength 0 (through
> disease)?
>

kali's fang does "2 aggravated damage each strike" (card text). strength
doens't matter here.

the term melee weapon doesn't imply that the strength concept is used here.
it only qualifies kali's fang as melee weapon. so you could use lucky blow
or undead strength with it.

take a look at bang-nakh - tiger's claws. here the strength concept is used
because it says "strength+2 damage each strike" on the card. again the term
melee waepon doesn't tell us if strength is used or not.

It does 2 agg each strike, regardless of the minion's strength
